name: Date Calculator
description: Days between dates, date arithmetic, working days with Chinese public holidays, and a lunar calendar
help: Difference: enter two dates (2025-01-31, 2025/1/31 or 20250131), optionally with a time such as 2025-01-31 08:30. The result shows days, years-months-days, weeks and total hours, minutes and seconds. Turn on "Include end date" to count both days, as when counting days of leave.

Working days are counted Monday to Friday, and also by the Chinese public holiday schedule, which skips holidays and counts the weekend make-up workdays. Holiday data is published one year at a time; later years fall back to plain weekends.
Add & subtract: years and months are added first, then weeks, days and times. A date at the end of a month stays at the end, so 31 January plus one month is 28 or 29 February.
Working days mode finds the date N working days before or after the start date, not counting the start date.

Calendar: each day shows its lunar date, solar terms and festivals, with 休 / 班 marking public holidays and make-up workdays. Select a day to see its ISO week, day of year, lunar year, zodiac and more.

Zodiac: look up the Chinese zodiac and star sign from a Gregorian or lunar birthday, with the difference between counting from Lunar New Year and from Lichun; personality notes are for fun. The calendar details now show the stem-branch year, month and day, the moon phase and almanac do's and don'ts (folklore for reference). Lunar dates: keep lunar birthdays and anniversaries with each year's Gregorian date and a countdown.
